description:
Conservation-led replacement of existing street-facing window and entrance-door joinery at an existing residential flat within the St Mary Magdalene Conservation Area. At ground floor, retain and locally repair the existing painted stucco architectural framework and principal opening, while replacing the current sash-style window and entrance-door joinery with a coordinated bespoke painted-timber frontage, clear glazing, fixed fanlight and a four-panel timber entrance door finished in Little Greene Canton™ No. 94. At first floor, replace the existing street-facing sash windows with visually restrained painted-timber imitation sash windows retaining the established sash-window appearance, proportions and overall rhythm. No enlargement of the principal opening and no additional floor space are proposed.
Written advice with site visit	£584	£116.80	£700.80
